info.title: Shared Mailbox Categories
info.description: Sets Outlook categories on messages in the configured shared mailbox. The built-in Office 365 Outlook connector cannot set categories on shared mailbox messages.

post.summary: Set categories on a shared mailbox message
post.description: Adds, replaces or removes Outlook categories on a message in the shared mailbox. Idempotent: repeating a call has no further effect.

parameters.name: x-correlation-id
parameters.description: Optional value written to the function's logs, e.g. the flow run ID: workflow()?['run']?['name']

404.description: Message not found in the shared mailbox

409.description: internetMessageId matched more than one message

500.description: App Service Authentication is disabled; the function refuses requests until it is restored

502.description: The function's identity cannot access the mailbox (configuration problem)

503.description: Microsoft Graph unavailable after retries; safe to retry

messageId.description: The 'Message Id' from the 'When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)' trigger.

internetMessageId.description: Use instead of Message Id if the message may have been moved to another folder.

categories.description: Category names, one per item. Names that don't exist in the mailbox's master list still apply but show without a colour.

mode.description: add (keep existing categories), replace (overwrite all), or remove.

changed.description: False if the message already had the requested categories.
